annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2001/92/EC of 30 October 2001 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 92/22/EEC on safety glazing and glazing materials on motor vehicles and their trailers and Council Directive 70/156/EEC relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2001/92/EC of 30 October 2001 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 92/22/EEC on safety glazing and glazing materials on motor vehicles and their trailers and Council Directive 70/156/EEC relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 291, 8.11.2001
annotation.summary_en: An EU Commission Directive that updates the type-approval rules for safety glazing on motor vehicles and their trailers to reflect technical progress. It replaces the technical requirements of Directive 92/22/EEC with UN/ECE Regulation No 43, adds standard information documents and certificates, and sets transition dates. It has nothing to do with AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States must grant EC type-approval to safety glazing that meets the structural and testing requirements in the Annexes
The technical requirements of Directive 92/22/EEC are replaced by those of UN/ECE Regulation No 43
From 1 October 2002, EC type-approval of a vehicle type is no longer granted if its glazing does not meet the amended requirements
Spare parts for vehicles already in use may still be approved under the previous rules
Member States must transpose the Directive by 30 June 2002
